metadata.description: This document details the refund policy for academic, hostel, and mess fees for the 2026-2027 admissions at Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology, specifying deadlines and conditions for partial and full refunds.

result.title: THAPAR INSTITUTE OF ENGINEERING & TECHNOLOGY, PATIALA
result.summary: The partial document outlines the refund policy for admissions at Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology for the academic year 2026-2027. It specifies that for academic fees, a full refund minus Rs. 1000 is available if admission is withdrawn on or before July 20, 2026, with no refund available after this date. For hostel and mess fees, a 75% refund is available if vacated within 4 weeks of the start of classes, a 50% refund if vacated between 4 to 8 weeks, and no refund after 8 weeks. The start date for classes will be announced on the institute's website.
result.text:
THAPAR INSTITUTE OF ENGINEERING & TECHNOLOGY, PATIALA  
18th June , 202 6 
Admissions 202 6-2027 Refund Policy  
 
As per the academic calendar issued by AICTE, the Institute shall follow the refund 
policy in accordance with the details given below.  
 
Academic Fee  
  
Date of Admission Withdrawal   Amount to be refunded  
On or before July 20th, 202 6 Full fee refund  after deducting Rs. 1000/ - 
After July 20th, 202 6 Nil  
 
Hostel and Mess Fee  
 
Hostel Vacation Date  Amount to be refunded  
Within 4 weeks of start of classes  75% of the (Hostel + Mess fee ) 
After 4 weeks but within 8 weeks of start of classes  50% of the (Hostel + Mess fee ) 
After 8 weeks of start of classes  No Refund  
 
Information regarding the start of classes will be uploaded on the website later on.  
 
 
Sd/- 
Registrar
